title: Centered column title for Open Day
goal: Center the two column titles within their respective areas, maintaining the alignment of the description paragraphs.
summary: text-align controls the horizontal alignment of text and other inline content within the block. When setting the entire range, the paragraphs inside may also inherit the same alignment.
tasks: Find two column titles with section-title class, and set their text-align to center.
Keep description paragraphs in columns aligned to the left.

example.note: Use this rule in the amount column of the receipt to align the right edge of the value.

hint: When the description paragraph is also centered, check whether the rule selects the entire section. Narrow the selection to the section-title class.
